Two importer/provider routes:
  A) full EMD trailing-directory importer
  B) independently supplied six-section provider using verified offsets

Both routes serialize to:
  canonical bytes = 283734
  FNV-1a32 = C2104AE0
  memcmp = identical for all 283734 bytes

The canonical comparison intentionally ignores absolute file offsets and compares
semantic/raw model content instead. A provider can relocate sections without
changing the expected canonical result.
